# netbox_circuit_termination (Resource)

Manages a NetBox circuit termination (`/api/circuits/circuit-terminations/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_circuit_termination" "example" {
  circuit_id = netbox_circuit.example.id
  term_side = "A"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `circuit_id` (Number) ID of the Circuit (`netbox_circuit`).
- `term_side` (String) Term Side. Valid values: `A`, `Z`.

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) Treat as if a cable is connected. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `port_speed` (Number) Physical circuit speed.
- `pp_info` (String) Patch panel ID and port number(s). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `termination_id` (Number) Termination Id.
- `termination_type` (String) Termination Type.
- `upstream_speed` (Number) Upstream speed, if different from port speed.
- `xconnect_id` (String) ID of the local cross-connect. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_circuit_termination can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_circuit_termination.example 123
```
